summary: Quality-driven Systems Administrator with nearly 7 years of experience aligning business systems with policies and guidelines. Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with a proven track record of improving system reliability and customer satisfaction.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist
responsibilities: Maintained and troubleshot complex infrastructure, providing first‑level help desk support.
Diagnosed and isolated hardware failures, coordinating replacements with vendors.
Monitored network and system performance, optimizing utilization and ensuring uptime.
Performed operating system and application monitoring, including COTS and custom software.
Documented incidents and maintained shift logs and ticketing records.
Analyzed customer needs, generated requirements, and implemented functional plans.

experience.title: Systems Engineer
responsibilities: Obtained mission‑related certifications and trained team members on application services.
Conducted system health analysis, low‑level testing, and problem analysis for servers and desktops.
Coordinated design and integration with partners, ensuring requirements were met.
Developed bug fixes and patch sets for web applications.
Diagnosed UNIX and Windows processing issues and implemented solutions.
Maintained network, system, and data availability through preventative maintenance.

experience.title: Systems Engineer Associate
responsibilities: Coordinated weekly seminars and delivered training for the VA‑95 Technical Resource Center.
Created and updated electronic training content for the technical library.
Served as Windows SME, researching and recommending COTS products for closed‑caption video.
Managed candidate recruitment data and assisted with HR paperwork.
